Name: Legacy Greenhouse
Author: ItsLunatyx
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/ad9ba70ea672c9c111af5c1e526bbdf2.png[/img]﻿
⭐Fully compatible with 1.6! ⭐[/center]

[center]A large, three-room Greenhouse, originally created to use with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18905]Legacy Farm[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18954]Legacy Farm Cave[/url], 
but should be compatible with most farm maps![/center]
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/af3746312e20e5b4feff8af21cc121ec.png[/img][/center]⭐A small decorated entry way, that leads onto the three main Greenhouse rooms!
⭐A main central room with plenty of planting areas!
⭐Two side rooms that are perfect for smaller planting areas or trees!
⭐A large basement are for production or storage!
⭐A garden area! 


[center]***The garden area is technically still classed as 'inside' so will work just like the rest of the Greenhouse,
where you can plant from any season.***
[img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/86ac1e8835784d0e6ec619f9aa378a68.png[/img][/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18905]⭐[/url]In the screenshots, I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6008]Indoor Apiary[/url] to make beehives work in the Greenhouse, or in any indoor location. 

I'm still very new to this and learning as I go, but I'm having so much fun. All your feedback, amazing comments and support have meant the world to me, so thank you! I hope you have as much fun with this as I am and enjoy it!
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/9c6d1fa62de3b81eadefd6872f5a9bdb.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18905]⭐[/url]﻿I have also uploaded an optional version with an 'empty' entry way, with the decorations in the main version removed.﻿[/center][center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/f1100fb863a2eb8e787f60100e0aefcf.png[/img][/center]
[center][youtube]jawZvSIaw0w[/youtube][/center]

I thought I'd put together a video to show the mods I've created so far for Stardew Valley, so you can see them in game! All are fully compatible with the latest 1.6 update! Time stamps and links are below for your convenience so you can skip to any particular mod you want to see. Thank you for all the amazing comments and feedback on Nexus so far, I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you continue to have fun with these and enjoy them as much as I am!  PS I realised I forgot to show the vineyard in Legacy Farm but I'll make sure to next time! There are pictures on Nexus <3
